notes.title: Seen Before - Early Access Released !
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576681/6cd5bbf314702fd1ec85d6e45e297937344f35cd.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Seen Before - Early Access[/b] launches with its first two maps.
You have accepted the devil’s offer: to play three games in exchange for your deepest desire. Trapped within looping environments, you must detect anomalies and choose the correct door. Confront your fears and push forward toward your goal.[/p][p]If you can win all three games, what you long for will be yours.[/p][p]Step into an intense and thought-provoking psychological thriller experience.[/p]
